name: Thanksgiving Special
source:
The CD has five mini games that come in the form of three Adventure games, Jan-Ken-Pon and a Shooter game. 
Gameplay of the Adventure games is linear.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=503&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
这张光盘收录了五个小游戏，包括三个冒险游戏、猜拳和一个射击游戏。冒险游戏的玩法是线性的。

[来自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=503&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
